notes.title: Improved Navigation: WASD Movement Support Added
notes.notes:
Players can now navigate maps using the familiar WASD keys in addition to mouse dragging.

This new control option allows faster and more comfortable exploration, especially during repetitive searches.

No gameplay changes; this update focuses solely on enhancing movement convenience.

We appreciate your feedback and will continue improving your gameplay experience.

notes.title: Challenge Mode Difficulty Further Reduced (3rd Adjustment)
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

Based on your valuable feedback, we have made a third round of difficulty reductions to Challenge Mode. The details of these changes are as follows:

Changes
Starting time increased:
30 seconds → 60 seconds

Bonus time for finding objects:
Increased by 100% compared to before

Bonus time for finding a Chest:
15 seconds → 60 seconds

We hope these adjustments make Challenge Mode more enjoyable and accessible for everyone.
As always, we appreciate your feedback and encourage you to keep sharing your thoughts with us!

Thank you.

notes.title: Additional Difficulty Reduction for Challenge Mode
notes.notes:
Based on player feedback following the previous Challenge Mode nerf, we have further reduced the difficulty of Challenge Mode.

* Increased Additional Time for Combos
* The extra time awarded based on the number of combos has been increased by 10% to 40%.

* Enhanced Time Bonus for Item Collection
* The time bonus granted when collecting items has been increased by 10% to 20%, depending on the item type.

We appreciate your valuable feedback and will continue to strive to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience.

notes.title: [Update] Challenge Mode Difficulty Adjustment
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team.

Based on your valuable feedback, we have made adjustments to make Challenge Mode more accessible and enjoyable.
With this update, you can experience a more casual and rewarding Challenge Mode!

[Challenge Mode Changes]

- The starting time for Challenge Mode has been increased from 20 seconds to 30 seconds.

- The time bonus for finding items has been increased by 60% to 80%, depending on the item type.

- The time bonus for finding a Chest has been significantly increased from 5 seconds to 15 seconds.

We will continue to listen to your feedback and work hard to make the game even better.
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch Note For June 12
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your valuable feedback and support!
This update focuses on improving the quest experience and dialogue readability based on recent player suggestions.

* Improved the visibility of quest givers.

* Fixed line break issues in English in-game dialogue. (Other languages will be updated in a future patch.)

* Fixed an issue where Steam Achievements were not working due to an incorrect app ID. Achievements should now unlock properly.

* Other minor bug fixes and adjustments.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Finding Pots & Pets launches on June 11!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45520393/ccaf77e2a187146c3738a77eaf312ce56467e57b.png[/img]Hi everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Finding Pots & Pets will launch on Steam on June 11, 2025!

It’s a cozy pixel art hidden object game set in Bunnyland, featuring over 3,000 pets and pots to find, plus a challenge mode for those who want to test their skills.

Thank you so much for your support and for wishlisting the game so far. We can’t wait to share the world of Bunnyland with you soon!

If you have any questions or feedback, feel free to leave a comment below.

See you on June 11!
